from collections import deque
MOV={'UP':(-1,0),'DOWN':(1,0),'LEFT':(0,-1),'RIGHT':(0,1)}
PLUS=(2,9); RAIN=(9,5); NOOK=(10,10)
NOOK_SHAPE='O.O/O../OOO'   # nook glyph shape in O-notation (== 'b.b/b../bbb')
def freemap(fr):
    cm=build_map5(fr)
    FREE={k for k,v in cm.items() if v in '.MY+B'} | {(9,5),(9,10)}
    YL=frozenset(k for k,v in cm.items() if v=='Y')
    return FREE,YL
def bfs(start,ic,col,bud,YL,FREE,goal_pos):
    st0=(start,ic,col,bud,YL); prev={st0:None}; q=deque([st0]); goal=None
    while q and goal is None:
        s=q.popleft(); p,i,c,b,y=s
        if p in goal_pos and i==2 and c==1: goal=s; break
        if b<=0: continue
        for d,(dm,dn) in MOV.items():
            n=(p[0]+dm,p[1]+dn)
            if n==NOOK or n not in FREE: continue
            ni=(i+1)%4 if n==PLUS else i
            nc=(c+1)%4 if n==RAIN else c
            ny=y; nb=42 if n in y else b-2
            if n in y: ny=frozenset(x for x in y if x!=n)
            st=(n,ni,nc,nb,ny)
            if st not in prev: prev[st]=(s,d); q.append(st)
    if goal is None: return None
    path=[]; s=goal
    while prev[s] is not None:
        pp,d=prev[s]; path.append(d); s=pp
    return list(reversed(path))
def state_idx(fr):
    col,pat = icon_state(fr)
    m={'OOO/..O/O.O':0,'O.O/..O/OOO':1,'O.O/O../OOO':2}
    ic = m.get(pat,3) if col!='N' else 3
    c = {'O':0,'b':1,'N':2,'R':3}.get(col,0)
    return ic,c,pat
log=[]
FREE,YL = freemap(current_frame)
pl = bfs((9,1),0,0,42,YL,FREE,{(1,10)})
print('initial plan len', len(pl))
for it in range(50):
    fr=current_frame; pos=macro3(fr); bud=budget(fr); ic,c,pat=state_idx(fr)
    if pos==(1,10) and pat==NOOK_SHAPE and ic==2 and c==1:
        log.append(('READY',it)); break
    FREE,YL = freemap(fr)
    p = bfs(pos,ic,c,bud,YL,FREE,{(1,10)})
    if not p:
        log.append(('NOPATH',it,pos,ic,c,bud)); break
    act=p[0]; exp=(pos[0]+MOV[act][0],pos[1]+MOV[act][1])
    r=action([act])
    if r['level_completed']: log.append(('WIN',it+1,act)); break
    if r['game_over']: log.append(('DEAD',it+1,act)); break
    if not r.get('board_changed',True): log.append(('NOOP',it+1,act,pos)); break
    npos=macro3(current_frame)
    if npos!=exp: log.append(('PUSH',it+1,act,str(pos),str(npos)))
print(log)
print('final pos',macro3(current_frame),'icon',icon_state(current_frame),'budget',budget(current_frame),last_action_call_result['state'])

def tstate(a):
    # V bar col = W col ; measure V bar rows excluding dot pixels by checking column of W
    W=Wpos(); c=W[1]
    rows=[r for r in range(64) if a[r][c]=='b']
    # crossbar row: row (other than W row) with many b in contiguous run
    best=None
    for r in range(64):
        run=max([len(s) for s in __import__('re').findall(r'b+',a[r])] or [0])
        if run>5: best=(r,)
    hs=[r for r in range(64) if 'bbbbb' in a[r]]
    spans=[(r,__import__('re').search(r'b+',a[r]).start(),[m.span() for m in __import__('re').finditer(r'b+',a[r])]) for r in hs]

def lines(a):
    import collections
    b=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(a) for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='b']
    rr=collections.Counter(p[0] for p in b); cc=collections.Counter(p[1] for p in b)
    hrow=[r for r,n in rr.items() if n>5]; vcol=[c for c,n in cc.items() if n>5]
    hs=[(r,min(p[1] for p in b if p[0]==r),max(p[1] for p in b if p[0]==r)) for r in hrow]
    vs=[(c,min(p[0] for p in b if p[1]==c),max(p[0] for p in b if p[1]==c)) for c in vcol]
    return sorted(hs),sorted(vs),Wpos(),len(b)
